title: 第十一章 拳风乍起显威能第十二章 族老惊疑测根骨
content_zh:
“拿下这孽障！生死勿论！”
楚雄那饱含家主威压和冰冷杀意的厉喝，如同滚雷炸响在官道之上！他端坐高头大马，山羊胡微微抖动，细长的眼睛死死盯着楚夜，如同在看一个死人。昨晚那诡异的爆发，今日这凶悍的手段…这废物身上绝对有古怪！必须拿下，拷问出秘密，然后彻底除掉！
“遵命！家主！”
“拿下这小杂种！”
“剁了他！”
楚雄身后那七八个气息彪悍的护院精锐，齐声应诺，眼中爆发出嗜血的凶光！他们可不是楚彪手下那些只会仗势欺人的草包，而是真正见过血、练过硬功夫的楚家核心打手！个个太阳穴高鼓，气血充盈，手持的刀剑棍棒在阳光下闪烁着寒芒！
七八道身影如同出笼的恶虎，带着凌厉的杀气，瞬间从马背上跃下，呈扇形朝着楚夜猛扑过来！动作迅猛，配合默契，瞬间封死了楚夜所有闪避的空间！刀光如雪，棍影如林，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，当头罩下！目标不仅是楚夜，连他身后的柳氏也笼罩在内！显然是要斩草除根！
“夜儿！”柳氏看着这凶险的一幕，吓得面无血色，失声尖叫，下意识地想扑上来挡在儿子身前！
“娘！退后！”楚夜一声低喝，声音沉稳如铁，带着不容置疑的力量！他左手闪电般探出，轻轻一带，一股柔和却沛然莫御的力道瞬间将柳氏送到了身后数丈外相对安全的一棵大树旁。
与此同时，面对那铺天盖地、足以将寻常武者瞬间分尸的刀光棍影，楚夜那双沉寂的黑眸深处，一点混沌初开般的灰色微光，骤然亮起！
嗡！
后背脊骨深处，混沌道骨发出低沉而充满战意的嗡鸣！皮肤下那玄奥的青黑色纹路瞬间蔓延至双臂，如同活物般搏动！一股难以形容的、精纯无比、蕴含着至高法则意蕴的混沌力量，如同沉寂的火山，轰然爆发！
他没有闪避！不退反进！
就在那七八件兵刃即将及体的瞬间——
楚夜动了！
他的动作并不快得离谱，甚至带着一种奇异的韵律感，却精准、简洁到了极致！仿佛能预判到每一道攻击的轨迹！
只见他身体如同没有骨头的柳絮，在刀光棍影的缝隙间极其诡异地一扭！一把劈向他肩膀的钢刀擦着衣角划过！一根砸向他后脑的熟铜棍被他微微侧头，险之又险地避过！
同时，他那紧握的右拳，如同蛰伏已久的毒龙，猛地捣出！目标，直取冲在最前方、手持鬼头刀、气息最凶悍的那个刀疤脸护院的胸口！
这一拳，没有任何花哨！就是最纯粹、最直接的力量爆发！拳头表面，一层极其凝练、近乎实质的混沌灰芒骤然亮起！所过之处，空气发出不堪重负的、低沉的爆鸣！拳未至，一股沉重如山岳、带着毁灭气息的恐怖拳风，已然狠狠撞在刀疤脸护院的胸膛之上！
“什么？！”刀疤脸护院脸上的狞笑瞬间凝固！他只感觉一股无法抗拒的巨力如同攻城锤般狠狠撞来！护体的气血劲力如同纸糊般瞬间崩溃！胸口传来一阵令人牙酸的骨裂声！他甚至连惨叫都来不及发出，整个人就如同被狂奔的蛮牛撞中，口喷鲜血，倒飞出去！手中的鬼头刀脱手飞出，当啷一声掉在地上！身体重重砸在官道旁的土坎上，抽搐了两下，便没了声息！

一拳！毙杀一名锻骨境巅峰的护院精锐！
这恐怖的一幕，让剩下的护院攻势瞬间一滞！所有人眼中都充满了惊骇和难以置信！这…这他娘的是什么力量？！
“点子扎手！一起上！别给他喘息的机会！”一个领头的护院最先反应过来，厉声嘶吼，压下心中的恐惧，手中长枪如同毒蛇吐信，带着尖锐的破空声，直刺楚夜咽喉！枪尖寒芒闪烁，显然淬了剧毒！
另外几人也被惊醒，压下恐惧，凶性大发！刀剑棍棒再次化作一片死亡风暴，更加疯狂地朝着楚夜周身要害招呼过来！这一次，他们不再留手，招招致命！
“找死！”楚夜眼神冰冷，杀意更盛！
他身形如同鬼魅般晃动，在密集的攻击中穿梭！每一次移动都妙到毫巅，险之又险地避开致命的攻击！同时，他的双手化作了最恐怖的武器！
砰！咔嚓！
一个使铁鞭的护院，手腕被楚夜如同铁钳般抓住，轻轻一捏，腕骨瞬间粉碎！铁鞭脱手！
“啊——！”凄厉的惨嚎刚起，楚夜一个肘击，狠狠撞在其咽喉！惨嚎戛然而止，那人捂着脖子，眼球暴凸，软软倒地！
嗤啦！
一柄淬毒短剑悄无声息地刺向楚夜肋下！楚夜看也不看，左掌如刀，带着混沌灰芒闪电般反切！那精钢打造的短剑如同朽木般应声而断！掌缘去势不减，狠狠劈在那偷袭者的脖颈上！颈骨碎裂声清晰可闻！
content_en:
"Take down this evil obstacle! No matter life or death!"
Chu Xiong's fierce shout, full of the patriarch's pressure and cold murderous intent, was like rolling thunder exploding on the official road! He sat upright on his tall horse, his goatee trembled slightly, and his slender eyes stared at Chu Ye, as if he were looking at a dead person. The weird outburst last night, the ferocious method today...there is definitely something weird about this trash! It must be captured, tortured to reveal the secret, and then eliminated completely!
"As you command! Master!"
"Get this little bastard!"
"Chop him!"
Behind Chu Xiong, the seven or eight elite guards with strong auras all agreed in unison, with a bloodthirsty light erupting in their eyes! They are not the idiots under Chu Biao who only know how to bully others, but the core thugs of the Chu family who have actually seen blood and practiced hard kung fu! Their temples were bulging, their energy and blood were full, and the swords and sticks they held shone coldly in the sun!
Seven or eight figures were like evil tigers emerging from their cages. With fierce murderous intent, they jumped off the horse in an instant and pounced towards Chu Ye in a fan shape! The quick movements and tacit cooperation instantly blocked all Chu Ye's dodge space! The light of the sword is like snow, the shadow of the stick is like a forest, with a scream that tears the air, when the hood is down! The target is not only Chu Ye, but also the Liu family behind him! It is obviously necessary to eradicate the root!
"Ye'er!" Mrs. Liu looked at this dangerous scene, her face turned pale with fright, she screamed, and subconsciously wanted to rush up and block her son!
"Mom! Back off!" Chu Ye shouted, his voice as steady as iron, with undoubted power! He stretched out his left hand like lightning, and with a gentle movement, a soft but powerful force instantly sent Liu to a relatively safe big tree a few feet away behind her.
At the same time, facing the overwhelming shadows of swords and sticks that could instantly cut an ordinary warrior into pieces, in the depths of Chu Ye's silent black eyes, a gray glimmer like the beginning of chaos suddenly lit up!
Buzz!
Deep in the spine of the back, the Chaos Dao Bones hummed low and full of war intent! The mysterious blue-black lines under the skin instantly spread to both arms, pulsing like a living thing! An indescribable, extremely pure, chaotic force that contains the meaning of the supreme law, erupts like a silent volcano!
He didn't dodge! Don’t retreat but advance!
At the moment when the seven or eight weapons were about to reach his body——
Chu Ye moved!
His movements are not ridiculously fast, and even have a strange sense of rhythm, but they are extremely precise and concise! It's as if he can predict the trajectory of every attack!
His body was like a boneless willow catkin, twisted in an extremely weird way between the light of the sword and the shadow of the stick! A steel knife struck at his shoulder and scratched the corner of his clothes! A cooked copper stick hit the back of his head, but he turned his head slightly and narrowly avoided it!
At the same time, his clenched right fist suddenly came out like a poisonous dragon that had been dormant for a long time! The target is to go straight to the chest of the scar-faced guard who is rushing forward, holding a ghost-headed sword, and having the most ferocious aura!
There is nothing fancy about this punch! It is the purest and most direct burst of power! On the surface of the fist, an extremely condensed, almost substantial layer of chaotic gray light suddenly lit up! Wherever it passed, the air emitted an overwhelming, low roar! Before the punch came, a terrifying fist wind that was as heavy as a mountain and carried a destructive aura had already hit Scarface Guard's chest hard!
"What?!" The ferocious smile on Scar-faced Nursing Home's face froze instantly! He only felt an irresistible force hitting him like a battering ram! The energy and blood of the bodyguard collapsed instantly like paper! There was a heartbreaking sound of bone cracking coming from the chest! He didn't even have time to scream, as his whole body was hit by a running bull, blood spurted from his mouth, and he flew backwards! The Ghost Head Sword flew out of his hand and fell to the ground with a clang! The body hit the ridge next to the official road heavily, twitched twice, and then became silent!
One punch! Kill an elite guard at the peak of the Bone Forging Realm!
This horrific scene made the remainingThe guard's offensive stalled instantly! Everyone’s eyes were filled with horror and disbelief! This... what the fuck is this power? !
"The idea is so thorny! Let's go together! Don't give him a chance to breathe!" A leading guard was the first to react. He roared loudly, suppressing the fear in his heart. The spear in his hand was like a poisonous snake spitting a message, with a sharp sound of breaking through the air, and it pierced Chu Ye's throat! The tip of the spear flashed with cold light, obviously quenched with poison!
Several other people were also awakened. They suppressed their fear and became ferocious! The swords and clubs once again turned into a death storm, attacking Chu Ye's vital points even more crazily! This time, they won't hold back any more and will use their deadly moves!
"Seeking death!" Chu Ye's eyes were cold and his murderous intent was even stronger!
His body swayed like a ghost, weaving in and out of intensive attacks! Every move is exquisite, and fatal attacks are narrowly avoided! At the same time, his hands turned into the most terrifying weapons!
Bang! Click!
A guard who wielded an iron whip had his wrist grabbed by Chu Ye like an iron pincer. With a gentle squeeze, his wrist bones instantly shattered! Get rid of the iron whip!
"Ah——!" As soon as the shrill scream started, Chu Ye gave him an elbow and hit his throat hard! The howling suddenly stopped, the man covered his neck, his eyes bulged, and he fell to the ground softly!
Tsk!
A poison-quenched short sword stabbed Chu Ye's ribs silently! Chu Ye didn't even look at it, his left palm was like a knife, and he cut back like lightning with a chaotic gray light! The dagger made of fine steel broke like rotten wood! The force of the palm edge continued unabated, and it struck the sneak attacker's neck hard! The cracking sound of the neck bones can be clearly heard!
